Description: DRAFT. The Application Context of the Secretary of a meeting in the Metaverse (MMM) for the JSON Interface (MMC-JSI): the Access entry ApplicationContext of the L3 of the JSON Interface for MMM (1MMC-JSI-V2.5-I03). The commands are those of the User Command (MMM-UCM-V2.2).
Application: The Secretary is a User of a meeting in a metaverse. A participant, represented by a User that is shown as an avatar, speaks to the Secretary and asks it for things: a summary of the meeting so far, in a language and written or spoken; to raise or lower the participant's hand; to switch the participant's microphone on or off; to share the participant's screen in the room or stop sharing it; to close the meeting for everybody (the convener only, after the Secretary has asked to be sure); to hide the summary or stop reading it; and to answer in a written form too. When the participant has done, it asks to go back to the meeting. The Secretary answers in a few spoken words.
Conventions: Languages are given by their ISO 639-1 codes: en English, el Greek, fr French, de German, es Spanish, pt Portuguese, it Italian, ja Japanese, zh Chinese. Without a language the summary is in English, or in the language of the request before. Without a form it is written, or in the form of the request before; Japanese and Chinese can only be written. 'Show me', 'write', 'on my display' and 'in writing' mean Written; 'read it', 'tell me', 'say' and 'out loud' mean Spoken. A request may ask for more than one thing, each is a field of UserCommandRQ. Closing the meeting is never done on the first request: the Secretary asks to be sure, and a plain yes after it is Confirm true, a no is Confirm false. 'Thank you', 'that is all', 'back to the meeting' and 'goodbye' are ReturnToMeeting.

Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.Summary: A summary of the meeting so far, for this participant only. Language and Form only if the participant says them.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.Display: Hide: take the summary off the display. StopReading: stop the Secretary reading the summary aloud.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.Answers: How the Secretary answers from now on: Written (the default), on the display only, or Spoken, by voice as well as on the display.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.Hand: Raise or lower the participant's hand: to ask for the floor, or to give it up.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.Microphone: Switch the participant's microphone on or off: mute, unmute.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.Screen: Share the participant's screen in the room or stop sharing it.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.CloseMeeting: True to close the meeting for everybody: only the convener, and only after the Secretary has asked to be sure.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.Confirm: True for a yes to the question the Secretary asked, false for a no.
Descriptions.UserCommandRQ.ReturnToMeeting: True when the participant has done with the Secretary: thank you, that is all, back to the meeting.
